blocks.text: The romantic pop ballad serves as the new theme song of Someone, Someday, capturing the vulnerability and uncertainty of falling for a closest friend. James Reid and Kathryn Bernardo explore unspoken confessions in “Aaminin,” a romantic pop ballad that serves as the new official theme song of the hit teleserye Someone, Someday. Lyrically inspired by the familiar yet complicated territory of falling for a close friend, “Aaminin” captures the longing, vulnerability, and uncertainty that can change a relationship forever.
